shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at 2 on the number line in the left image with the marker at 7 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The bounded interval excludes its endpoint 2. Right image: The depicted right-side interval excludes its left endpoint 7.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image excludes the indicated boundary point. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
